Meta Opened Free Access to Muse AI Agent with 100M Tokens per Week

@Meta launched Muse — a personal #AI agent that works 24/7 across your email, browser, and connected services, and it's now free with up to 100M tokens per week.

Built with Zuckerberg's "personal superintelligence" pitch in mind, Muse runs in an isolated cloud VM and never touches your real credentials directly — a separate Sentinel system approves or blocks every action, network request, and payment. Prompt injection defenses, surrogate payment tokens, and single-use cards round out the security model, and Meta is now offering researchers up to $300K in bug bounties (up to $130K for a critical instruction-hijack exploit).

It's a serious bet that agentic AI can be made safe enough for real-world autonomy — email, shopping, background tasks — without handing over the keys.

quote:
📰 #imNEWS: @Meta launched Muse, a personal AI agent that talks like a chat in the Muse app or WhatsApp, powered by Muse Spark. It runs in a dedicated Muse Secure VM, can keep working after you close the app, and asks before emails or purchases. Link by Stripe covers agent checkout with one-time cards. US rollout on iOS, Android, and https://t.co/gSNkgq6rfh, free for most use, with subscriptions for more.

🔑 3 Key Takeaways

① An agent that keeps working
Muse is built for everyday tasks (email, travel) and bigger goals. Share a goal, it builds a plan, then it can open a browser, fill forms, and negotiate. For longer jobs it keeps going after you close the app and comes back when something changes or it needs approval.

② A dedicated VM, not a chat overlay
Muse Secure VM is a contained cloud computer for the agent plus your data and credentials. A separate Sentinel agent has to approve anything that hits the internet. Muse cannot see passwords or payment methods. A Confidential VM later this year encrypts the whole box with a key only the user holds.

③ Checkout and memory with limits
Muse can pay with Link, including purchase protections and one-time cards. Shop Pay and 1Password support are coming. It can turn a saved Instagram recipe reel into a grocery list and remember dietary restrictions. You pick app access, can disconnect anytime, and can opt out of training.

✅ Action Item
Run one real task in Muse this week (book something, dispute a bill, or checkout). Write down where it asked for approval vs acted on its own. If you sell via WhatsApp or Instagram, that log is your map for how consumer agents will sit between you and the customer.

Source: https://t.co/EDoNj2gvJw
